name: smwmusic-final-zone-ii-randy-hansen
title: Final Zone II - Randy Hansen
description:
A near perfect recreation of the Hansen song from Final Zone II, which is short yet has a lot of percussion to keep the tonality alive, and can fit in more calmer areas.

There are two versions included: An HQ version which is more cleaner but omits some of uncommon SMW samples,
or the SMW versions which keeps all the samples in tact by losing quality.

Released in C3 Winter 2022.
